description: Ma Chao, splendid chinese cavalry general in the supplied pixel art style, riding a white war horse. A silver lion-crested helmet with a tall white plume, white fur over silver armor, a teal sash, a long white cape. White horse with teal and gold tack. He holds a very long spear with a teal tassel in the right hand
face: A proud handsome young face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the silver helmet with the white plume, white fur shoulders, the long white cape hanging over the horse's rump, the horse's tail between its hind legs.
guard_action: the rider brings the spear from upright to a ready angle; the horse stands still on four legs

actions.idle: Mounted fighting guard, horse standing still on four legs, breathing
actions.move: Seamless gallop in place, rider carrying the spear, no attack. The four legs follow the skeleton. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a2: Mounted VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-5 the spear is raised above the head; frames 5-6 the horse lifts both front hooves; frames 7-8 the hooves come down and the spear is brought down from above, its point landing in front of the horse while the hands stay close to the chest; frames 9-11 hold.
actions.b1: Mounted RISING strike. Frames 3-6 the spear point hangs low behind on the right side of the horse; frames 7-8 it swings up from below through the target; frames 9-11 it finishes high.
actions.s2: Cavalry charge. Frames 2-8 the horse gallops in place, the spear lowered beside its neck; frame 9 a forehoof lifts; frame 10 it lands and the spear strikes; frames 11-12 hold.
actions.s3: Entry and braking strike. Frames 1-6 the horse sits low on its haunches, the rider crouched over the saddle; frames 7-8 the horse brakes, lifting its forehand, and the spear strikes; frames 9-12 hold.
actions.a3: Overhead turn with both hands. Frames 3-4 both hands come together at the middle of the pole and lift it above the head; frames 5-11 the spear makes ONE full level turn above the head like a propeller: the point goes back, then right, then FRONT at frame 8 (the blow), then left, then back again; frames 12-15 it is lowered to the ready pose. The horse stands still.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a3 → b3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 원화의 무기가 본보다 훨씬 길어(약 170~200px) 캔버스에 안 들어간다. weapon_mode slide: 무기 끝은 본의 위치 그대로, 남는 길이는 손 뒤로 보낸다. 공격 중에는 손이 자루 가운데쯤을 잡고, 대기에서는 원화의 그립으로 돌아온다.
